---
title: "Population Change Arrows"
subtitle: "An arrow connects the positions in 1980 and 2015 of each city on this population x inequality chart. Color encodes variation."
format: html
engine: knitr
---

Recreates [Population Change
Arrows](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/population-arrows.html) from
the mosaic/vgplot example gallery (adapted from an [Observable Plot
example](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-arrow-variation-chart)).

```{r setup}
library(vgplotr)
```

```{r}
bend <- param(bend)

arrows <-
  vg_mark_arrow(
    data_from = "metros",
    x1 = ~POP_1980,
    y1 = ~R90_10_1980,
    x2 = ~POP_2015,
    y2 = ~R90_10_2015,
    bend = bend,
    stroke = ~ sql("R90_10_2015 - R90_10_1980")
  ) |>
  vg_mark_text(
    data_from = "metros",
    x = ~POP_2015,
    y = ~R90_10_2015,
    filter = ~highlight,
    text = ~nyt_display,
    fill = "currentColor",
    dy = -6
  ) |>
  vg_guide_all(grid = TRUE) |>
  vg_scale_all(inset = 10) |>
  vg_scale_x(type = "log") |>
  vg_guide_x(label = "Population →") |>
  vg_guide_y(label = "↑ Inequality", ticks = 4) |>
  vg_scale_color(scheme = "BuRd") |>
  vg_guide_color(tick_format = "+f") |>
  vg_plot(name = "arrows")

spec <-
  vg_create() |>
  vg_meta(
    title = "Population Change Arrows",
    description = "An `arrow` connects the positions in 1980 and 2015 of each city on this population x inequality chart. Color encodes variation.",
    credit = "Adapted from an [Observable Plot example](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-arrow-variation-chart)."
  ) |>
  vg_data(name = "metros", file = vg_example_url("metros.parquet")) |>
  vg_params(bend = TRUE) |>
  vg_vconcat(
    vg_legend_color(
      for_plot = "arrows",
      label = "Change in inequality from 1980 to 2015"
    ),
    arrows,
    vg_menu(label = "Bend Arrows?", options = c(TRUE, FALSE), as = bend)
  )

vg_render(spec)
```

<details>
<summary>Comparing to mosaic's own JSON spec</summary>

```{r}
cat(to_json(spec))
```

Matches [mosaic's own JSON
spec](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/population-arrows.html) exactly,
aside from `data.metros.file` (`vg_example_url()` vs. a relative path) and
object key order.
</details>
